diff --git a/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89f281ae3eb669386a9cf1620835002e5b5b51ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  traceCombatantLine,
+  type CornerPoint,
+  type TerrainCornerLineTrace,
+} from '../../../src/combat/cover';
+import type { EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';
+import type { CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';
+import { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText, createEngineMcpRuntime } from '../../../src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '../../../src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { availableEngineActorOptions, resolveEngineActorOption } from '../../../src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '../../../src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+import { brutalRoomMembershipViolations } from '../../../tools/d569-second-family-manifest';
+import { buildHostScenarioMenu } from '../../../src/vtt/speculative-planning';
+
+const OFFER_ENVIRONMENT = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+
+function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new TypeError('Expected a record.');
+  }
+  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
+}
+
+function position(state: EncounterState, id: CombatantId): unknown {
+  return state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === id)?.position ?? null;
+}
+
+function seam(sourceCorner: CornerPoint, line: TerrainCornerLineTrace): unknown {
+  if (!line.blocksSight || line.firstBlockingCell === null) return null;
+  if (sourceCorner.row === line.targetCorner.row && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.row)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'horizontal',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row + 1 },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  if (sourceCorner.column === line.targetCorner.column && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.column)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'vertical',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column + 1, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function traceEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId, targetId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, actorId, targetId);
+  return {
+    targetId,
+    targetPosition: position(state, targetId),
+    tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    rays: trace.lines.map((line) => ({
+      targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight,
+      firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell,
+      seam: seam(trace.sourceCorner, line),
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sceneEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const players = state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+    entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+  return {
+    actorId,
+    actorPosition: position(state, actorId),
+    labels: availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT).map((option) => option.label),
+    targets: players.map((player) => traceEvidence(state, actorId, player.profile.id)),
+  };
+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal/seed-${String(6_203_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_b: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});

diff --git a/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89f281ae3eb669386a9cf1620835002e5b5b51ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  traceCombatantLine,
+  type CornerPoint,
+  type TerrainCornerLineTrace,
+} from '../../../src/combat/cover';
+import type { EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';
+import type { CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';
+import { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText, createEngineMcpRuntime } from '../../../src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '../../../src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { availableEngineActorOptions, resolveEngineActorOption } from '../../../src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '../../../src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+import { brutalRoomMembershipViolations } from '../../../tools/d569-second-family-manifest';
+import { buildHostScenarioMenu } from '../../../src/vtt/speculative-planning';
+
+const OFFER_ENVIRONMENT = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+
+function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new TypeError('Expected a record.');
+  }
+  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
+}
+
+function position(state: EncounterState, id: CombatantId): unknown {
+  return state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === id)?.position ?? null;
+}
+
+function seam(sourceCorner: CornerPoint, line: TerrainCornerLineTrace): unknown {
+  if (!line.blocksSight || line.firstBlockingCell === null) return null;
+  if (sourceCorner.row === line.targetCorner.row && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.row)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'horizontal',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row + 1 },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  if (sourceCorner.column === line.targetCorner.column && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.column)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'vertical',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column + 1, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function traceEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId, targetId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, actorId, targetId);
+  return {
+    targetId,
+    targetPosition: position(state, targetId),
+    tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    rays: trace.lines.map((line) => ({
+      targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight,
+      firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell,
+      seam: seam(trace.sourceCorner, line),
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sceneEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const players = state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+    entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+  return {
+    actorId,
+    actorPosition: position(state, actorId),
+    labels: availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT).map((option) => option.label),
+    targets: players.map((player) => traceEvidence(state, actorId, player.profile.id)),
+  };
+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal/seed-${String(6_203_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_b: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});

diff --git a/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89f281ae3eb669386a9cf1620835002e5b5b51ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  traceCombatantLine,
+  type CornerPoint,
+  type TerrainCornerLineTrace,
+} from '../../../src/combat/cover';
+import type { EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';
+import type { CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';
+import { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText, createEngineMcpRuntime } from '../../../src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '../../../src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { availableEngineActorOptions, resolveEngineActorOption } from '../../../src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '../../../src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+import { brutalRoomMembershipViolations } from '../../../tools/d569-second-family-manifest';
+import { buildHostScenarioMenu } from '../../../src/vtt/speculative-planning';
+
+const OFFER_ENVIRONMENT = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+
+function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new TypeError('Expected a record.');
+  }
+  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
+}
+
+function position(state: EncounterState, id: CombatantId): unknown {
+  return state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === id)?.position ?? null;
+}
+
+function seam(sourceCorner: CornerPoint, line: TerrainCornerLineTrace): unknown {
+  if (!line.blocksSight || line.firstBlockingCell === null) return null;
+  if (sourceCorner.row === line.targetCorner.row && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.row)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'horizontal',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row + 1 },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  if (sourceCorner.column === line.targetCorner.column && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.column)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'vertical',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column + 1, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function traceEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId, targetId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, actorId, targetId);
+  return {
+    targetId,
+    targetPosition: position(state, targetId),
+    tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    rays: trace.lines.map((line) => ({
+      targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight,
+      firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell,
+      seam: seam(trace.sourceCorner, line),
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sceneEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const players = state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+    entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+  return {
+    actorId,
+    actorPosition: position(state, actorId),
+    labels: availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT).map((option) => option.label),
+    targets: players.map((player) => traceEvidence(state, actorId, player.profile.id)),
+  };
+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal/seed-${String(6_203_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_b: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});

diff --git a/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89f281ae3eb669386a9cf1620835002e5b5b51ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  traceCombatantLine,
+  type CornerPoint,
+  type TerrainCornerLineTrace,
+} from '../../../src/combat/cover';
+import type { EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';
+import type { CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';
+import { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText, createEngineMcpRuntime } from '../../../src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '../../../src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { availableEngineActorOptions, resolveEngineActorOption } from '../../../src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '../../../src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+import { brutalRoomMembershipViolations } from '../../../tools/d569-second-family-manifest';
+import { buildHostScenarioMenu } from '../../../src/vtt/speculative-planning';
+
+const OFFER_ENVIRONMENT = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+
+function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new TypeError('Expected a record.');
+  }
+  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
+}
+
+function position(state: EncounterState, id: CombatantId): unknown {
+  return state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === id)?.position ?? null;
+}
+
+function seam(sourceCorner: CornerPoint, line: TerrainCornerLineTrace): unknown {
+  if (!line.blocksSight || line.firstBlockingCell === null) return null;
+  if (sourceCorner.row === line.targetCorner.row && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.row)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'horizontal',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row + 1 },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  if (sourceCorner.column === line.targetCorner.column && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.column)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'vertical',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column + 1, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function traceEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId, targetId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, actorId, targetId);
+  return {
+    targetId,
+    targetPosition: position(state, targetId),
+    tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    rays: trace.lines.map((line) => ({
+      targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight,
+      firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell,
+      seam: seam(trace.sourceCorner, line),
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sceneEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const players = state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+    entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+  return {
+    actorId,
+    actorPosition: position(state, actorId),
+    labels: availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT).map((option) => option.label),
+    targets: players.map((player) => traceEvidence(state, actorId, player.profile.id)),
+  };
+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal/seed-${String(6_203_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_b: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});

+}

+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),

+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});

diff --git a/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89f281ae3eb669386a9cf1620835002e5b5b51ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  traceCombatantLine,
+  type CornerPoint,
+  type TerrainCornerLineTrace,
+} from '../../../src/combat/cover';
+import type { EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';
+import type { CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';
+import { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText, createEngineMcpRuntime } from '../../../src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '../../../src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { availableEngineActorOptions, resolveEngineActorOption } from '../../../src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '../../../src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+import { brutalRoomMembershipViolations } from '../../../tools/d569-second-family-manifest';
+import { buildHostScenarioMenu } from '../../../src/vtt/speculative-planning';
+
+const OFFER_ENVIRONMENT = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+
+function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new TypeError('Expected a record.');
+  }
+  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
+}
+
+function position(state: EncounterState, id: CombatantId): unknown {
+  return state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === id)?.position ?? null;
+}
+
+function seam(sourceCorner: CornerPoint, line: TerrainCornerLineTrace): unknown {
+  if (!line.blocksSight || line.firstBlockingCell === null) return null;
+  if (sourceCorner.row === line.targetCorner.row && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.row)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'horizontal',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row + 1 },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  if (sourceCorner.column === line.targetCorner.column && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.column)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'vertical',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column + 1, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function traceEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId, targetId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, actorId, targetId);
+  return {
+    targetId,
+    targetPosition: position(state, targetId),
+    tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    rays: trace.lines.map((line) => ({
+      targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight,
+      firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell,
+      seam: seam(trace.sourceCorner, line),
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sceneEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const players = state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+    entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+  return {
+    actorId,
+    actorPosition: position(state, actorId),
+    labels: availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT).map((option) => option.label),
+    targets: players.map((player) => traceEvidence(state, actorId, player.profile.id)),
+  };
+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal/seed-${String(6_203_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_b: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  traceCombatantLine,
+  type CornerPoint,
+  type TerrainCornerLineTrace,
+} from '../../../src/combat/cover';
+import type { EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';
+import type { CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';
+import { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText, createEngineMcpRuntime } from '../../../src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '../../../src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { availableEngineActorOptions, resolveEngineActorOption } from '../../../src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '../../../src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+import { brutalRoomMembershipViolations } from '../../../tools/d569-second-family-manifest';
+import { buildHostScenarioMenu } from '../../../src/vtt/speculative-planning';
+
+const OFFER_ENVIRONMENT = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+
+function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new TypeError('Expected a record.');
+  }
+  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
+}
+
+function position(state: EncounterState, id: CombatantId): unknown {
+  return state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === id)?.position ?? null;
+}
+
+function seam(sourceCorner: CornerPoint, line: TerrainCornerLineTrace): unknown {
+  if (!line.blocksSight || line.firstBlockingCell === null) return null;
+  if (sourceCorner.row === line.targetCorner.row && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.row)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'horizontal',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row + 1 },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  if (sourceCorner.column === line.targetCorner.column && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.column)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'vertical',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column + 1, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function traceEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId, targetId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, actorId, targetId);
+  return {
+    targetId,
+    targetPosition: position(state, targetId),
+    tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    rays: trace.lines.map((line) => ({
+      targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight,
+      firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell,
+      seam: seam(trace.sourceCorner, line),
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sceneEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const players = state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+    entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+  return {
+    actorId,
+    actorPosition: position(state, actorId),
+    labels: availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT).map((option) => option.label),
+    targets: players.map((player) => traceEvidence(state, actorId, player.profile.id)),
+  };
+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal/seed-${String(6_203_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_b: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});

diff --git a/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89f281ae3eb669386a9cf1620835002e5b5b51ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  traceCombatantLine,
+  type CornerPoint,
+  type TerrainCornerLineTrace,
+} from '../../../src/combat/cover';
+import type { EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';
+import type { CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';
+import { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText, createEngineMcpRuntime } from '../../../src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '../../../src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { availableEngineActorOptions, resolveEngineActorOption } from '../../../src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '../../../src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+import { brutalRoomMembershipViolations } from '../../../tools/d569-second-family-manifest';
+import { buildHostScenarioMenu } from '../../../src/vtt/speculative-planning';
+
+const OFFER_ENVIRONMENT = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+
+function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new TypeError('Expected a record.');
+  }
+  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
+}
+
+function position(state: EncounterState, id: CombatantId): unknown {
+  return state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === id)?.position ?? null;
+}
+
+function seam(sourceCorner: CornerPoint, line: TerrainCornerLineTrace): unknown {
+  if (!line.blocksSight || line.firstBlockingCell === null) return null;
+  if (sourceCorner.row === line.targetCorner.row && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.row)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'horizontal',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row + 1 },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  if (sourceCorner.column === line.targetCorner.column && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.column)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'vertical',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column + 1, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function traceEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId, targetId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, actorId, targetId);
+  return {
+    targetId,
+    targetPosition: position(state, targetId),
+    tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    rays: trace.lines.map((line) => ({
+      targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight,
+      firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell,
+      seam: seam(trace.sourceCorner, line),
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sceneEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const players = state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+    entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+  return {
+    actorId,
+    actorPosition: position(state, actorId),
+    labels: availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT).map((option) => option.label),
+    targets: players.map((player) => traceEvidence(state, actorId, player.profile.id)),
+  };
+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal/seed-${String(6_203_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_b: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});

diff --git a/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89f281ae3eb669386a9cf1620835002e5b5b51ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  traceCombatantLine,
+  type CornerPoint,
+  type TerrainCornerLineTrace,
+} from '../../../src/combat/cover';
+import type { EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';
+import type { CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';
+import { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText, createEngineMcpRuntime } from '../../../src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '../../../src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { availableEngineActorOptions, resolveEngineActorOption } from '../../../src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '../../../src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+import { brutalRoomMembershipViolations } from '../../../tools/d569-second-family-manifest';
+import { buildHostScenarioMenu } from '../../../src/vtt/speculative-planning';
+
+const OFFER_ENVIRONMENT = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+
+function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new TypeError('Expected a record.');
+  }
+  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
+}
+
+function position(state: EncounterState, id: CombatantId): unknown {
+  return state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === id)?.position ?? null;
+}
+
+function seam(sourceCorner: CornerPoint, line: TerrainCornerLineTrace): unknown {
+  if (!line.blocksSight || line.firstBlockingCell === null) return null;
+  if (sourceCorner.row === line.targetCorner.row && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.row)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'horizontal',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row + 1 },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  if (sourceCorner.column === line.targetCorner.column && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.column)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'vertical',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column + 1, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function traceEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId, targetId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, actorId, targetId);
+  return {
+    targetId,
+    targetPosition: position(state, targetId),
+    tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    rays: trace.lines.map((line) => ({
+      targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight,
+      firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell,
+      seam: seam(trace.sourceCorner, line),
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sceneEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const players = state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+    entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+  return {
+    actorId,
+    actorPosition: position(state, actorId),
+    labels: availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT).map((option) => option.label),
+    targets: players.map((player) => traceEvidence(state, actorId, player.profile.id)),
+  };
+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal/seed-${String(6_203_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_b: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});

diff --git a/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..89f281ae3eb669386a9cf1620835002e5b5b51ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/vtt/land-04-diagnostic.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import {
+  traceCombatantLine,
+  type CornerPoint,
+  type TerrainCornerLineTrace,
+} from '../../../src/combat/cover';
+import type { EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';
+import type { CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';
+import { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText, createEngineMcpRuntime } from '../../../src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '../../../src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { availableEngineActorOptions, resolveEngineActorOption } from '../../../src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '../../../src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+import { brutalRoomMembershipViolations } from '../../../tools/d569-second-family-manifest';
+import { buildHostScenarioMenu } from '../../../src/vtt/speculative-planning';
+
+const OFFER_ENVIRONMENT = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+
+function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
+  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new TypeError('Expected a record.');
+  }
+  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
+}
+
+function position(state: EncounterState, id: CombatantId): unknown {
+  return state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === id)?.position ?? null;
+}
+
+function seam(sourceCorner: CornerPoint, line: TerrainCornerLineTrace): unknown {
+  if (!line.blocksSight || line.firstBlockingCell === null) return null;
+  if (sourceCorner.row === line.targetCorner.row && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.row)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'horizontal',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row + 1 },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  if (sourceCorner.column === line.targetCorner.column && Number.isInteger(sourceCorner.column)) {
+    return {
+      orientation: 'vertical',
+      flanks: [
+        line.firstBlockingCell,
+        { column: line.firstBlockingCell.column + 1, row: line.firstBlockingCell.row },
+      ],
+    };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function traceEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId, targetId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, actorId, targetId);
+  return {
+    targetId,
+    targetPosition: position(state, targetId),
+    tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    rays: trace.lines.map((line) => ({
+      targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight,
+      firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell,
+      seam: seam(trace.sourceCorner, line),
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sceneEvidence(state: EncounterState, actorId: CombatantId): unknown {
+  const players = state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+    entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+  return {
+    actorId,
+    actorPosition: position(state, actorId),
+    labels: availableEngineActorOptions(state, actorId, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT).map((option) => option.label),
+    targets: players.map((player) => traceEvidence(state, actorId, player.profile.id)),
+  };
+}
+
+const FAMILY_PATHS = {
+  hard: Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-${String(5_117_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal/seed-${String(6_203_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_b: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-b/seed-${String(6_206_001 + index)}.json`),
+  brutal_2: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) =>
+    `tests/fixtures/arena-basis-brutal-2/seed-${String(6_207_001 + index)}.json`),
+} as const;
+
+function familyCount(paths: readonly string[]): unknown {
+  let attackOrSaveOffers = 0;
+  let zeroAttackMonsters = 0;
+  let monsters = 0;
+  for (const path of paths) {
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    for (const monster of state.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster')) {
+      monsters += 1;
+      let attackOffers = 0;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(state, monster.profile.id, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT)) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, OFFER_ENVIRONMENT);
+        if (!resolution.valid) continue;
+        const kinds = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.map((slot) => slot.kind);
+        if (kinds.some((kind) => kind === 'attack' || kind === 'saving_throw')) attackOrSaveOffers += 1;
+        if (kinds.includes('attack')) attackOffers += 1;
+      }
+      if (attackOffers === 0) zeroAttackMonsters += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  return { attackOrSaveOffers, zeroAttackMonsters, monsters };
+}
+
+describe('LAND-04 diagnostics', () => {
+  it('prints reconciled investigation evidence', () => {
+    for (let seed = 6_203_001; seed <= 6_203_010; seed += 1) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_PRODUCTIVITY ${String(seed)} ${JSON.stringify(
+        brutalRoomMembershipViolations(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'brutal' })),
+      )}`);
+    }
+
+    const composite = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117005.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    console.log(`LAND04_COMPOSITE ${JSON.stringify(sceneEvidence(
+      composite,
+      'combatant:generated-5117005-monster-3' as CombatantId,
+    ))}`);
+
+    const room8 = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/room8-repro/seed-5117008.SIMULATED.json',
+      'utf8',
+    )));
+    const room8Actor = 'combatant:generated-5117008-monster-1' as CombatantId;
+    const room8Runtime = createEngineMcpRuntime(room8, {
+      requestedActorIds: [room8Actor], revision: 203, room: 8, offerEnvironment: OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    });
+    const room8Play = record(room8Runtime.toolSurface.execute('engine.propose_from_play', {
+      play_name: 'basic_advance',
+    }));
+    console.log(`LAND04_ROOM8 ${JSON.stringify({
+      ...record(sceneEvidence(room8, room8Actor)),
+      basicAdvance: room8Play['proposals'],
+    })}`);
+
+    const speculative = decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(
+      'tests/fixtures/arena-basis-hard/seed-5117001.json',
+      'utf8',
+    ));
+    const actors = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'monster').slice(0, 2);
+    const players = speculative.combatants.filter((entry) =>
+      entry.life === 'living' && entry.profile.kind === 'player_character');
+    const menu = buildHostScenarioMenu(
+      speculative,
+      actors.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      players.map((entry) => entry.profile.id),
+      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
+    );
+    console.log(`LAND04_SPECULATIVE ${JSON.stringify({
+      baselineProposals: menu.baselineProposals,
+      scenarioMenu: menu.scenarioMenu,
+      actors: actors.map((entry) => sceneEvidence(freshMonsterPlanningState(speculative), entry.profile.id)),
+    })}`);
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+
+  it('prints family offer counts', () => {
+    for (const [family, paths] of Object.entries(FAMILY_PATHS)) {
+      console.log(`LAND04_COUNT ${family} ${JSON.stringify(familyCount(paths))}`);
+    }
+    expect(true).toBe(true);
+  }, 30_000);
+});
